android.desc:
Two balls are moving, and both need your attention.

Tap the blue or red ball to bounce it. Watch both paths, time your touches, and build your score in a colorful pixel art arcade game.

Choose your challenge:

- Classic: Keep both balls in play. Each tap adds to your score.
- Threes: A white bonus ball appears. Bounce it to earn its increasing point value.
- Walls: Aim for the side walls to score, but watch out for the top wall.
- Opposite: Blue rises while red falls. Time your taps around opposite gravity.

Each mode has its own high score to chase. Connect to Google Play Games to view leaderboards and compare scores.

quotes.text:
I wanted to learn game development so decided to create this simple yet challenging mobile game. You need fast reflexes to score higher :)

It is using Flutter and Flame Engine.

Over the past 2 months, I've added 4 modes of different difficulties.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.two.balls.game

Would appreciate any kind of feedback.
Thanks.
